Seven fixes are folded in: (1) the analyzer hunks for tests/test_research_results.py now carry their own `diff --git` / `---` / `+++` headers, so `git apply` no longer attributes them to scripts/research_results.py; (2) `lane_active` is no longer turned into a fabricated `unknowns` entry - it is documented in `evidence[\\\"lane_active\\\"]` and in the report, and its `success_context_verified` flag is derived from the existing hard checks (`not problems`, `cost_state == 0b110`, p4m present, `not p4m_problems`) instead of the invalid `a_done == a_issue` proxy, so a natural whole-arm A carry-out is not misjudged; the pre-existing `arm_done == arm_done_all` style checks are kept; (3) the E2 presence-change cross-check uses the target's own first probe (time and bitmap); the legacy field name `changing_events_between_deadline_and_probe` is kept as a compatibility alias of the canonical `changing_events_between_deadline_and_own_probe`; (4) an every-16 fixed-sampling-phase bias note is added and the sample statistics are explicitly not extrapolated to the whole A population; (5) the E2 dst-first test is replaced by a real A-phase eviction of DST -> DST first miss -> DST refill -> SRC probe fixture that would raise a false alarm on the old code, and the forward-order / same-cycle / missing-event tests are kept; (6) the CostAnalyzerTests block now asserts `v_lane == False / a_lane == True` for `lane_active == 2`, adds a natural arm issue>done carry-out case, A-final-incomplete and victim-quarantine negatives and a missing-p4m-field negative, and asserts `unknowns == []` where the value is known; (7) tests/test_research_solo_driver.py no longer hand-copies any UAPI struct, idma.c private ceiling or errno value - it copies linux/include/uapi/linux/idma.h into a temporary include/linux/idma.h reached with -I, extracts the private `#define IDMA_*` object macros from idma.c, uses host <errno.h> (positive EINPROGRESS), and still extracts the same four real functions (idma_validate, idma_p4m_validate, idma_research_validate, idma_run_research) plus the Solo page-count mutation. The patch deliberately touches only scripts/research_results.py and tests/test_research_results.py and avoids the mode-selection area and any new independent test class that another worker owns.\",\n
